description: Labeled symbol-shaped and natural-language search probes over the Python polyglot calibration corpus (ledger / transaction reconciliation domain).

probes.query: restrict a day index so it never falls outside a window's start and end
merge two overlapping date ranges into a single combined window
look up a stored balance for an account, falling back to zero when the account has no record
build a one-line human-readable summary for a reconciliation discrepancy
search a list of ledger entries for one matching a specific reference string
figure out whether the credits and debits in a batch balance out within an allowed tolerance
